PhysicsDriveAPI.physics:damping.source: if linear drive: mass/second If angular drive: mass*DIST_UNITS*DIST_UNITS/second/degrees.

PhysicsDriveAPI.physics:maxForce.source: if linear drive: mass*DIST_UNITS/second/second if angular drive: mass*DIST_UNITS*DIST_UNITS/second/second inf means not limited. Must be non-negative.

PhysicsDriveAPI.physics:stiffness.source: if linear drive: mass/second/second if angular drive: mass*DIST_UNITS*DIST_UNITS/degrees/second/second.

PhysicsDriveAPI.physics:targetPosition.source: if linear drive: distance if angular drive: degrees.

PhysicsDriveAPI.physics:targetVelocity.source: if linear drive: distance/second if angular drive: degrees/second.

PhysicsLimitAPI.physics:high.source: degrees or distance depending on trans or rot axis applied to. inf means not limited in positive direction.

PhysicsLimitAPI.physics:low.source: degrees or distance depending on trans or rot axis applied to. -inf means not limited in negative direction.

PhysicsPrismaticJoint.physics:lowerLimit.source: distance. -inf means not limited in negative direction.

PhysicsPrismaticJoint.physics:upperLimit.source: distance. inf means not limited in positive direction.

PhysicsRevoluteJoint.physics:lowerLimit.source: degrees. -inf means not limited in negative direction.

PhysicsRevoluteJoint.physics:upperLimit.source: degrees. inf means not limited in positive direction.
